physicalNotes: Radius 0.338 +/- 0.014 solar radii from Yalçinkaya et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1743 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.209Y/abstract): 235,147 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.339 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Yalçinkaya et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1743 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.209Y/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3277 +/- 78 K from Yalçinkaya et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1743 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.209Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
